title: Ind-constructible sheaves are closed under filtered colimits and sums
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and a separated scheme $X$ of finite type over $k$, in the standing geometric setting of the source. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and a finite intermediate extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $\Lambda=\underline E$ or $\underline{\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell}$ be the condensed coefficient ring of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. Work in $\mathcal M=\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}(\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\operatorname{Ab}))$, the internal-module category of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], with $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$. Let $\operatorname{Cons}(X,\Lambda)$ use the finite constant local-model convention of [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and let $\operatorname{IndCons}(X,\Lambda)$ consist of the objects isomorphic to small filtered colimits in $\mathcal M$ of constructible objects. Here small means small in the chosen universe of the site and coefficient sheaves.

If $(B_\lambda)_{\lambda\in I}$ is a small filtered diagram in $\operatorname{IndCons}(X,\Lambda)$, then its colimit $B$ in $\mathcal M$ belongs to $\operatorname{IndCons}(X,\Lambda)$. For every small set $S$, the direct sum in $\mathcal M$ of a family $(B_s)_{s\in S}$ in $\operatorname{IndCons}(X,\Lambda)$ belongs to $\operatorname{IndCons}(X,\Lambda)$, including $S=\varnothing$.

proof.text: The standing finite-type hypotheses make X locally Noetherian and quasi-compact. By det-ind-heart-full-faithfulness, every constructible object is finitely presentable in the ambient module category. Regard any given filtered colimit cocone as a ColimitPresentation. Mathlib ObjectProperty.ind_ind then identifies ind(ind P) with ind P, proving closure under filtered colimits without canonical presentations.

Constructibility is invariant under isomorphisms: retain each finite constant model and compose its local-model isomorphism with the inverse of the pulled-back isomorphism. Apply this on all strata, also after restriction to affine opens in the non-qcqs convention. By det-lem-coefficient-heart-closure the constructible full subcategory is abelian and its inclusion preserves finite colimits. Its finite coproduct cocones therefore give ambient finite coproducts of constructible objects, including the empty coproduct.

For a finite family of ind-constructible objects, choose small filtered presentations. Their product category is small and filtered. Each coordinate evaluation is final, so reindexing its presentation along evaluation remains colimiting. Assemble these cocones in the category of families, then apply the coproduct functor, which preserves colimits. The resulting filtered presentation of the finite coproduct has constructible stages by the preceding step. This works for the empty family, whose product category has a unique object.

The finite subsets of any small index set form a small filtered poset. Mathlib CoproductsFromFiniteFiltered.isColimitFiniteSubproductsCocone presents the arbitrary coproduct as the colimit of its finite subcoproducts. The preceding step puts those stages in ind P, and ObjectProperty.ind_ind applies again. Transfer to the given colimiting cofan by its canonical colimit-point isomorphism.
